svg.title: Research overview of the Multiscale Mechanics Group
svg.desc: Three material systems (spider silk, gels, and 3D-printed actuators) shown across three length scales: single chains, networks, and materials and structures. Statistical mechanics links chains to networks, continuum mechanics links networks to structures, and 3D printing and mechanical testing connect the models to experiments.
svg.text: 3D printing and mechanical testing to validate and guide the models
